profiles.name: XNA 4.0 Windows content pipeline
profiles.description: The build-time assemblies. These run in the content build, not in the game, so nothing here is a runtime projection target for this package.

profiles.name: XNA 4.0 Windows complete reference set
profiles.description: Every Microsoft.Xna.Framework assembly XNA Game Studio 4.0 installs for the Windows target, runtime and build-time together. Discovery and reporting only: it deliberately mixes contracts that a single compile-time TypeScript surface must not merge.

profiles.name: XNA 4.0 Windows LIVE surface
profiles.description: GamerServices, Net and Avatar: the Windows assemblies a game references in addition to the runtime profile. They resolve against the runtime assemblies in the same directory but are a separate contract, because a build that omits them is still a complete XNA game.

profiles.name: XNA 4.0 Windows runtime
profiles.description: Seven XNA 4.0 Windows runtime assemblies; other platform and build-time profiles stay separate.

profiles.name: XNA 4.0 Xbox 360 reference set
profiles.description: The Xbox 360 target's assemblies, resolved against the .NET Compact Framework contracts shipped beside them. A separate platform contract, not a superset or subset of the Windows one.
